description:
Hey There Explorer!

We hope this message finds you with a cup of your favorite brew in hand and a smile on your face. If your vibe perfectly aligns with what we're brewing up at drinkroot, then we're thrilled to extend a sippingly special invitation to you. 

Sip, Sip, Hooray! Meet drinkroot

We're not just any wellness company; we're kava enthusiasts who’ve been in this industry for almost a decade, infusing life with remarkable wellness products that work. Our kava? Oh, they're a blend of pure goodness sourced from the finest farms, carefully curated, hand pulled and crafted with a whole lot of love. Think of us as your go-to for a genuine kava adventure that's soothing, invigorating, and absolutely Instagram-worthy.

 

Why Us? Why You?

  • Sip The best: Our kavas are not your typical big batch generic you see... well, everywhere; they're a whole different experience. You'll be introducing your audience to rare single origin varietals that are the crème de la crème of quality and experience

  • Rooted-elation: Health benefits, anyone? From clinically proven calming effects- soothing stressful evenings, to speeding up nervous system healing from alcohol abuse, or just being a social lubricant for the night,, our teas are all about sipping wellness.

  • Conscious Goodness: We're all about mindful living. We source sustainably and donate responsibly, ensuring that each cup of tea not just calms the day but also contributes to a better community focused on love, recovery, and connection.

  • Kava Tribe: We're not just a brand; we're a community of kava lovers who swear by our blends. Your followers will feel right at home with us.

 

Brew-tiful Benefits Await You:

Joining our affiliate program means unlocking a treasure chest of benefits:

  • Sip Commissions: Earn fantastic commissions on every sale made through your unique affiliate link. Cha-ching! 

  • Sip & Save: Give your followers exclusive deals on our products, and watch them thank you with a million likes.

  • Aesthetic Arsenal: Our stash of professionally designed banners, images, and content is all yours to create Insta-magic. 

  • BFF (Best Friend Forever) Support: Our team is your team. We're here to make this partnership a breeze, with all the support you need.

  • Monthly Tea-sures: Get your payouts promptly each month. The sooner you earn, the sooner you can splurge on more tea!

Brew-tifully Simple Steps:

  • Join the Tea Party: Sign up for our affiliate program – it's as easy as brewing a cup of tea.

  • Sip & Share: Grab our ready-to-use marketing materials and share your unique affiliate link with your audience. Get creative on Instagram, in your podcasts, or wherever your heart takes you.

  • Sip & Earn: Watch the magic happen! As your audience falls in love with a real kava experience, you earn commissions and spread tea-riffic vibes.

  • Sip & Track: Keep tabs on your performance and earnings in real-time through our nifty affiliate dashboard.

Let's Brew Some Magic, Shall We? ☕✨

We believe this partnership could be a recipe for epic success and happiness all around. If you're as excited as we are (and we're pretty kava-cited!), please reply to this message. We'll shower you with all the details you need to get started on this tea-rrific adventure.

Thanks a million for considering this journey with us. We're stoked about the possibility of spreading the love of kava together and making the world a safer, cozier place, one sip at a time.

Cheers to kava-spiring partnerships,🌟

Who Can Join:

Bloggers, Social Media Influencers, Streamers, Website Owners, redditors, Content Creators, Podcasters. Ask us if you're not on this list cause we're open to almost anything!

Anyone with an engaged audience interested in wellness, holistic lifestyle, and natural organic alternatives. 

 

Ready to Get Started?

Join our affiliate program today and start earning commissions while promoting drinkroot. Sign up now by clicking "apply" AND shooting us an email to hello@drinkroot.com with subject “Affiliate Program”. Please answer questions in email and we’ll review your application shortly.

 

  • My main channel (blog, ig, tiktok, youtube, etc):

  • I am located in: 

  • I’m excited to join the drinkroot team because:

 

Terms and Conditions:

  • Commissions are eligible for successful sales generated through your unique referral link.

  • Commissions are subject to a 30 day referral period.

  • drinkroot reserves the right to modify or terminate the affiliate program at any time.

  • We monitor and do not currently allow coupon/deal sites or affiliates of coupon sites to join. Posting your affiliate link on a coupon/deal site without prior approval will result in a permanent ban from the program.

 

We look forward to partnering with you and growing together!



FAQ’s

What marketing materials do you provide to affiliates?

We give banners, links, product images, general guidance for product shots

How do I track my earnings and referrals? - All earnings and referrals are easily tracked through our simple data dashboard on your affiliate page.

Is there a cookie duration or tracking period for referrals? - We honor 30 day click through cookie windows from your own content.

What happens if a customer I referred requests a refund or cancels their purchase? - Refunds or cancelled orders will be deducted proportionally from your earnings as soon as processed.

Are there geographic restrictions for affiliates? - There are no current geographical restrictions, however when we release new products, we cannot guarantee we will be able to send you samples if you live outside of the United States. (Shipping is an arm and a leg these days)

Can I refer other affiliates to your program? - Yes! We are building out a multi-tiered referral affiliate program within our current database. If you refer anyone, please let us know asap and we will tag them to be grandfathered into this referal structure

What is your policy on affiliate fraud or unethical practices? - The backbone of our brand is our honesty and transparency. Our family has always been deep followers of the law and doing what is right. Therefore, it should be to no surprise to hear that fraudulent and unethical practices will not be tolerated and will be dealt with to the highest extent of the law. If you are looking to scam someone’s credit cards, please look for another program. We're big fans of our close friends in the many law enforcement realms..
term_and_condition:
Welcome to drinkroot! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.


3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.


5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).


7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: kyle@drinkroot.com.


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to kyle@drinkroot.com for support.
